title: sweep.json
description: R-D10: a sweep is a record of its own: the base parameters, the parameters varied (each with explicit values or a generator with its seed), and the runs it spawned by id. Each run's `lineage.sweep` points back to `id`. Choices where the plan is silent: `base` holds parameter values (not sources) keyed by namespaced name; `vary` is a list of {param, values | generator}; a `generator` is {kind, ...} with free extra fields and a required integer `seed` when kind is `sampler` (so the sweep regenerates); `combine` says how several varied parameters combine (product by default, or zip).

code.description: Code name; omit when the sweep varies the `code` parameter itself (a cross-code comparison).

runs.description: Ids of the runs spawned, in spawn order.
